UserFavorite.title: UserFavorite
UserFavorite.description: A user's saved favorite match or sports channel synced across devices.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns this favorite item.

itemId.description: ID of the favorite match or channel.

title.description: Display title of the favorited match or channel.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when favorite was added (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when favorite was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudCatalogItem.title: CloudCatalogItem
CloudCatalogItem.description: Publicly broadcasted live match, channel, or global app config synced from Admin Panel.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user/admin who created this broadcast item.

title.description: Display title of the catalog item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/cloud_items/{itemId}.description: Public catalog items broadcasted to all authenticated users.
